title: Children’s Museum Oro Valley

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: All Field Trips are available for groups of 10 or more children and can be bilingual. We’ll read the story The Color Monster by Anna Llenas and explore how different colors can represent different feelings. Through playful discussion, children will identify emotions, make connections to their own experiences, and discover how all feelings are welcome. Children will then decorate their very own Color Monster, using colors to express their emotions and create a unique masterpiece to take home! Get ready to count, move, create, and play! We’ll kick things off by reading 10 Black Dots by Donald Crews, then get everyone up and moving with an interactive counting activity that keeps little bodies

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Looking for something different to do for your family reunion, company party, or group meeting? Then treat your guests to an event at the Children’s Museum Tucson! Our historic building and spacious courtyard in downtown Tucson provide a beautiful backdrop for your event, and your guests will have a ball checking out our fun exhibits! We offer 14 galleries of interactive exhibits including:Bodyology, Imagine It!, Sense of Place, Investigation Station, Electri-City …and more! Instead of hiring entertainment, let our exhibits entertain your guests! Of course, there is plenty of space for strolling musicians, magicians, or other performers if you choose! Available space for formal dining
